subject: Induction access timeline + redaction plan for auditor request
messages:
From: Charter Insight <auditor@charterinsight.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0000
Subject: Request: onboarding/offboarding proof for SOC2 spot-check

Hi Tessa —

Charter Insight is conducting a focused SOC2 spot-check for Redwood. For the personnel controls section we need the following artifacts for the sample population you previously agreed to (50 recent joins/leavers):

1) Redacted background check export (showing check type, date completed, redaction placeholders for SSNs/dob/email)
2) Training completion report for security awareness & data handling (timestamp + course id + completion status)
3) Badge/access deprovision log with timestamps for leavers (format: user id, badge id, last-access timestamp, deprovision timestamp)
4) Chain-of-custody statement: who prepared/redacted the files and when

Please provide these as CSV/PDFs. We need the files by EOD Thursday 2026-06-24 so the audit team can validate. If you anticipate any PII concerns, explain the redaction approach and provide a sample of the hashing/placeholder strategy.

If any of the items require IT/HR escalation, let us know the expected delivery timeline.

Thanks,
Gwen Mallory
Senior Auditor, Charter Insight
auditor@charterinsight.com

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Gwen Mallory <auditor@charterinsight.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding proof for SOC2 spot-check

Hi Gwen —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the requested artifacts. High-level plan:

- Redacted BG export: HR will produce a CSV where PII fields are replaced with deterministic hashes (sha256 truncated) and a redaction map is retained internally (not shared).
- Training report: training platform export with course IDs and ISO timestamps; personal emails will be removed.
- Badge deprovision log: security ops will export the access log showing last badge activity and the system deprovision timestamp.
- Chain-of-custody: I will prepare a short statement and include the names and email addresses of staff who performed redaction and validation.

Attachments: I will send the three artifacts as stubs (redacted files) once Monica confirms redaction is complete.

Question: would you prefer the files uploaded to a temporary Drive folder with viewer link, or a secure SFTP transfer? We can do either; Drive link is faster for this round.

Target delivery: partial exports by EOD 2026-06-19; final redacted artifacts by 2026-06-24. If anything slips, I will notify you immediately.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will include redacted-bg-checks_2026.csv, badge_deprovision_log_2026.pdf, training-completions_Q2-2026.xlsx)

Tessa / team —

We're on it. Internal breakdown and next steps: 

1) HR export owner: Monica Patel — will pull the BG and training exports from Workday and LMS. Deliverable: redacted-bg-checks_2026.csv and training-completions_Q2-2026.xlsx. Format: CSV + XLSX with header row. Redaction approach: replace full names/emails/SSNs/dob with deterministic sha256 hex (first 12 chars) and include an internal id column (hashed_id). No raw PII will leave our systems.

2) Security ops owner: Marcus Lin — will pull the access control/badge deprovision events from our physical access system and from Okta (last login + deprovision). Deliverable: badge_deprovision_log_2026.pdf (exported PDF with table). Include UTC timestamps.

3) Chain-of-custody: Jordan Blake — prepare a one-page statement listing each file, name/email of preparer, redaction method, date/time of redaction, QA person. Jordan: can you confirm you'll sign/approve?

Timeline: internal artifacts ready for redaction and QA by EOD 2026-06-19. Redacted exports uploaded to a controlled Drive folder by 2026-06-21 for a pre-check, final upload to auditor by 2026-06-24.

Risk notes: the main blocker is manual PII in free-text HR notes. I'll run a quick sweep and flag any entries that need manual redaction — expect a small follow-up on Friday morning.

Monica
HR Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
